def prime_count(n):
    """Returns pi(n), the number of primes less than or equal to n."""
    primes = []
    is_prime = [True] * (n + 1)
    is_prime[0] = is_prime[1] = False
    for p in range(2, n + 1):
        if is_prime[p]:
            primes.append(p)
            for i in range(p * p, n + 1, p):
                is_prime[i] = False
    return len(primes)
